issues.description: The Plus the Pup paper-bag puppet manipulative slide (M1_plus_puppet) shows an empty bordered lined-paper rectangle with the caption 'Plus the Adder puppet template'. There is no actual puppet template artwork rendered, just a blank writing area.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M1_plus_puppet so the slide shows the actual paper-bag puppet template with Plus the Adding Pup line art (front and back faces) ready to be cut and glued onto a paper bag.

issues.description: The Minnie the Mouse paper-bag puppet manipulative slide (M2_minnie_puppet) is an empty bordered lined rectangle with caption 'Minnie the Minus puppet template'. No actual puppet template is shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M2_minnie_puppet so the slide shows the paper-bag puppet template with Minnie the Minus Mouse art (a tiny detective with a magnifier).

issues.description: M4_two_colour_counters is described as 'Round counters, red on one side and yellow on the other,' but the hero shows a blank ten-frame with 5 black dots labelled 'Ten Frame' — the wrong asset. Teachers cannot see the two-colour counter that lessons 1-4 reference.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M4_two_colour_counters to render actual round counters showing the red/dark and yellow/light sides side-by-side, instead of a generic ten-frame.

issues.description: M5_fact_triangles is described as 'Set of 30 laminated triangle cards,' but the hero shows a 3x3 array of black dots labelled 'Array — 3 × 3'. There are no triangle fact-family cards visible — teachers and students cannot preview the manipulative used in lessons 1 and 3.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M5_fact_triangles to draw a sample triangle fact-family card (e.g., 4-3-7 with sum at the top and addends at the bottom), instead of an unrelated dot array.

issues.description: M6_doubles_dice slide shows a blank ten-frame as the hero with caption 'Ten Frame', but the description says 'Pair of large foam 1-10 dice'. Wrong asset rendered: dice are not shown at all.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M6_doubles_dice to render a pair of 1-10 dice (e.g., two cube faces showing pip arrangements or numerals 1-10) instead of a ten-frame.

issues.description: M8_paper_cookies should show '~30 printable paper cookie tokens (chocolate chip, oatmeal, sugar)' but the hero shows a 4x5 dot array labelled 'Array — 4 × 5'. No cookie shapes are visible. Teachers cannot preview the lesson 5 fair-share manipulative.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M8_paper_cookies to draw actual paper cookie tokens with chocolate chip / oatmeal / sugar styling and the half-line for the half-cookie demonstration.

issues.description: M9_share_plates description says 'Set of 5 paper plates per group' but the hero shows a blank ten-frame with caption 'Ten Frame'. Wrong asset rendered — paper plates are not visible.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M9_share_plates to draw actual paper plate circles ready for fair-share rounds instead of a generic ten-frame placeholder.

issues.description: Worksheet preview for Lesson 1 (Plus the Pup's Adding Machine) shows the hero as a blank lined writing area labelled 'Ws01 P3 Plus Two Paws' with caption 'Show your work below.' No actual ten-frame/treats/equations artwork is rendered as the printable worksheet hero.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the worksheet composer for Ws01 P3 so the hero panel shows actual content (e.g., Plus's two paws with treats and the addition equation) rather than an empty lined rectangle.

issues.description: Lesson 4 worksheet (Build It, Solve It) shows three identical instructions: '1. Read each story. 2. Read each story. 3. Read each story.' This is clearly a deduplication or composer error — there should be three distinct steps for the act-out / draw / equation pipeline.
issues.suggested_fix: Edit the worksheet JSON for Lesson 4 so the three student instructions are distinct (e.g., '1. Read each story. 2. Draw a tape diagram. 3. Write the equation.').

issues.description: Lesson 4 Action section bullet 'change-take-from (something is TAKEN AWAY from a…' is truncated mid-sentence with an ellipsis. The teacher cannot read the rest of the change-take-from definition without flipping to the lesson plan file.
issues.suggested_fix: Shorten the Action bullet text in the Lesson 4 lesson JSON or split across lines so the full 'something is TAKEN AWAY from a starting amount' definition fits on the slide.

issues.description: Summative rubric Expectation column truncates every B2.1-B2.5 cell with '…' (e.g., 'B2.1 use the properties of addition and subtraction,…') and several Level 1-4 descriptor cells also end with '…'. The achievement-level descriptors are partially hidden.
issues.suggested_fix: Widen the rubric columns or shrink the cell font so B2.1-B2.5 expectation text and Level 1-4 descriptors fit without ellipsis truncation.

summary: Eight blocking missing-asset issues dominate this deck: both character puppet templates (Plus, Minnie) render as blank lined rectangles, five manipulative slides (counters, fact triangles, doubles dice, paper cookies, share plates) show generic ten-frames or dot arrays instead of the asset described, and Lesson 1 worksheet hero is blank. Manipulative composer needs re-run; status revise_assets.
